caption: The drawing depicts a sculptural object that features a bird, likely a hawk or falcon, rendered in shades of brown and tan with detailed feather patterns and an alert posture, perched atop an irregularly shaped base. The bird has a hook-shaped beak, talons gripping the base, and wings folded against its body. On the left side of the base, there is a nest-like form containing another bird or chick with an open beak, oriented upward toward the standing bird. The base itself is oval and textured, with darker and lighter brown patches to suggest depth and surface variation, and there are reliefs of smaller animals—possibly rodents or birds—around its sides. The background is plain and off-white, isolating the object at the center of the composition.
title: Toy Bank: Bird Feeding its Young
